name: Kingrinder K6
details: Hand grinder with external adjustment: 60 clicks per rotation, counted anti-clockwise from zero. KINGrinder: don't grind at zero or below 15 clicks.

grindRanges.scale: clicks from zero (adjustment nut turned clockwise until it stops)

notes.aeropress: KINGrinder groups moka pot and AeroPress (60–80).
notes.immersion: KINGrinder gives French press as a single setting, 140 clicks, not a range.

rangeInfo.note: KINGrinder K4/K6 manual (hosted on Amazon), “Recommended grinder settings”, K6 column: Turkish coffee 28–40 clicks, espresso 40–60, moka pot/AeroPress 60–80, pour-over 80–100, French press 140. “One circle is equivalent to 60 clicks.”
